description: Dynamic step-up logging for ASP.NET Core with Serilog - automatically increase log verbosity when errors occur, with minimal performance overhead. Includes request body capture, sensitive data redaction, and OpenTelemetry metrics.
releaseNotes: v9.2.0 - Client identity on client errors and the token sid. Added: ClientIpLoggingOnClientError (Off, Prefix, Full, default Full); a 400 to 499 response logs ClientIp, ForwardedFor and the IP headers under the higher of this and ClientIpLogging, and RemotePort (with TrustForwardedHeaders RemoteIp) under Full; Sid (the sid claim, else ClaimTypes.Sid) next to Jti in the request summary and the completion event. Changed: RedactionExemptProperties defaults to ["Jti", "Sid"]; set [""] for the 9.1 behaviour. Dependencies: Serilog.AspNetCore 11.0.0 and Microsoft.Extensions.Http.Resilience 11.0.1 on net11.0, Microsoft.Extensions.Http.Resilience 10.11.1 on net10.0. See CHANGELOG.md, MIGRATION.md and ADRs 0044 and 0045. v9.1.0 - One line per failed request: RequestSummaryOnError (Keep, Omit, default Keep). With Omit and AlwaysLogRequestSummary, a request that fails (status 400 or above, or an unhandled exception) writes no request summary when its completion event is exported; the completion event carries the summary's fields instead at RequestSummaryDetail. When the completion event is not exported, the summary is still written. Fixed: with CaptureRequestBody, a request whose endpoint throws an unhandled exception has its body captured. See CHANGELOG.md and ADR 0043. v9.0.0 - Client address off by default (GDPR). Breaking: ClientIp, ForwardedFor and the audit SourceIp are left out, and X-Forwarded-For, Forwarded, X-Real-IP and X-Original-For are redacted in the logged Headers; request headers themselves are not changed. Added: ClientIpLogging and ClientIpAudit (Off, Prefix, Full, default Off); Prefix writes the client prefix in CIDR form, /24 for IPv4 and /48 for IPv6, masks ForwardedFor per entry and leaves out a value that does not parse. Set both to Full to keep the 8.x output. See CHANGELOG.md, MIGRATION.md and ADR 0042. v8.1.0 - Throw-site log scopes on exception events: an event that logs an exception carries the BeginScope and LogContext properties open where the exception was thrown, for the exception and its inner exceptions, the deepest throw site first; a property the event already has keeps its value. CaptureScopesOnException (default true) set to false turns it off. Adapted from Serilog.ThrowContext (MIT), see THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md and ADR 0038. Fixed: audit_spool_oldest_age_seconds and the OldestRecordMaxAge health signal no longer report a record already delivered while a rejected batch is redelivered record by record. See CHANGELOG.md. v8.0.0 - Smaller public surface and the record trace for stuck audit records. Breaking: StepUpLoggingController is created only by AddStepUpLogging (its constructors, SetSummaryLogger, the string EmitRequestSummary overload and LevelSwitch are no longer public; read CurrentLevel), and the ActivitySource instances on StepUpLoggingExtensions are replaced by the RequestLoggingActivitySourceName, ControllerActivitySourceName and BufferActivitySourceName constants. Added: an audit record whose delivery failed gets its own trace; its retry Warnings, its dead-letter Critical and one closing Information entry when it is finally delivered share it (source Lukdrasil.StepUpLogging.Audit.Delivery, ADR 0037). Fixed: AlwaysLogOutboundRequestSummary set after AddStepUpLogging takes effect, and TraceFlags is always 0 or 1. No option, log output or audit wire format changed. See CHANGELOG.md and MIGRATION.md. v7.4.0 - .NET 10 again and OTLP traces and metrics fixed: the package ships lib/net10.0 and lib/net11.0, so a .NET 10 project can move from 6.4.1 to 7.4.0. Fixed: with EnableOtlpExporter on and the OpenTelemetry SDK registered before AddStepUpLogging without an exporter, traces and metrics were never exported; the library now adds an OTLP exporter to the app's tracer and meter providers unless the app registers UseOtlpExporter or AddOtlpExporter, before or after AddStepUpLogging. See CHANGELOG.md. v7.3.0 - Source IP on the request completion event: the event written by UseStepUpRequestLogging carries ClientIp, Connection.RemoteIpAddress or the first X-Forwarded-For entry with TrustForwardedHeaders, as the request summary already did. See CHANGELOG.md. v7.2.0 - Generic host and CLI use: the Serilog OTLP sink waits at most OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TIMEOUT milliseconds (default 10000) for one export instead of the 100 s HttpClient default, so disposing the host no longer waits 200 s for a collector that never answers; a collector that answers within the timeout sees no change. WriteStartupSummary (default true) set to false leaves out the startup report Information line; its Warnings stay. See the README section Generic host and command-line tools and CHANGELOG.md. v7.1.0 - Native AOT ready: the library builds with IsAotCompatible and raises no trim or AOT warnings of its own. In an application published with PublishAot, the Serilog section works without Serilog:Using for the library's own sinks, enrichers, formatters and console themes, and the encrypted spool writes through source-generated JSON with the same wire bytes. Under JIT nothing changes. In a native image a config-only sink from another package needs a Serilog:Using entry, and an AuditEvent Data, OldValues or NewValues value must be one of the declared types. See the README section Native AOT and CHANGELOG.md. v7.0.0 - .NET 11: the package targets net11.0 only (breaking: a net10.0 project stays on 6.4.1), with Microsoft.Extensions.Http.Resilience 11.0.0 and OpenTelemetry 1.21.0. Options, log output and the audit wire format are unchanged. See CHANGELOG.md and MIGRATION.md. v6.4.1 - Short keys on the Minimal Text console line: with RequestSummaryDetail Minimal the Text console line writes t, l, tid or tp, src, msg and ex instead of Timestamp, Level, TraceId or traceparent, SourceContext, Message and Exception, and ConsoleTextProperties defaults to jti, mth, path, sc and ms, so the summary fields follow the message again. Full and Compact output, JSON console, OTLP and file are unchanged. See CHANGELOG.md. v6.4.0 - Request summary minimal keys: RequestSummaryDetail.Minimal writes the Compact fields of the inbound and outbound request summary under short keys (dir, mth, path, sc, ms, ck, ua, rt, ab, cid, ip, jti, hc, host), the template included, so the rendered message is the same. IsRequestSummary keeps its name. See CHANGELOG.md. v6.3.2 - Request summary fields on the Text console line: ConsoleTextProperties defaults to Jti, Method, Path, StatusCode and ElapsedMs, so a request summary line carries them as Key=value next to Message. A configured list still replaces the default. JSON console, OTLP and file are unchanged. See CHANGELOG.md. v6.3.1 - Text console line as logfmt: every item of the Text console line is written as Key=value (Timestamp, Level, TraceId or traceparent, SourceContext, Message, then ConsoleTextProperties, then Exception on the same line); values with a space, =, quote, backslash or control character are double-quoted and escaped. JSON console, OTLP and file are unchanged. See CHANGELOG.md. v6.3.0 - Request summary direction, detail and outbound summary (#91), additional exclude paths (#90): AdditionalExcludePaths (default none) is appended to the effective ExcludePaths and keeps the built-in defaults. Every request summary carries Direction (Inbound or Outbound), ClientKind from the User-Agent and new non-sensitive fields (Route, Aborted, ClientId; in Full also Protocol, Scheme, Host, content lengths, auth state and endpoint name). RequestSummaryDetail (Full or Compact, default Full) selects the fields. AlwaysLogOutboundRequestSummary (default false) writes one summary per IHttpClientFactory call. Changed: the summary template is now {Direction} {Method} {Path} {StatusCode} {ElapsedMs} ms {ClientKind} {UserAgent}, and UserAgent is always present, (none) when missing. See CHANGELOG.md. v6.2.0 - Redaction exemptions and a keyed console trace id (#87): RedactionExemptProperties (default empty) lists property names, such as Jti, whose values are never passed through RedactionRegexes, in the RedactLogEventProperties sweep and for Jti on the request summary and completion event; request inputs are always redacted. ConsoleTraceFormat (default TraceId) writes the Text console trace id as TraceId=<hex> or as a W3C traceparent=. Changed: the Text console line no longer writes the trace id as a bare token. See CHANGELOG.md. v6.1.0 - Audit rejection observer (#71): optional IAuditRejectionObserver singletons are told the status and top-level problem+json code of each record the endpoint rejects on its own, after it is dead-lettered, so a consumer can refresh its sealing key on 422 sealing.unknown_key; inform only, bounded by DeliveryTimeout, nothing changes when none is registered. See CHANGELOG.md. v6.0.0 - Configuration with production defaults. Breaking: DurationSeconds defaults to 3 instead of 180 (set 180 to keep the previous step-up window), OTLP export is on only when OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT is set (set EnableOtlpExporter true for a collector at the default localhost without the variable), and a configured NeverStepUpCategories list replaces the default, with [] clearing it. Startup report: one Information line with the effective configuration and a Warning for each unknown key under SerilogStepUp and each option with no effect. Options validation names each failing key and its value and checks RedactionRegexes. The README starts with what to set and what is on by default. See CHANGELOG.md and MIGRATION.md. v5.4.0 - Framework category defaults: FrameworkCategoryDefaults (default Recommended) floors ASP.NET Core hosting, routing, MVC, HTTP results, static files, HttpClient, Polly, EF Core command and Npgsql command categories at Warning and keeps them out of the pre-error buffer, so a failing request exports the application events and the summary; CategoryFloors entries override the defaults and None restores the previous behaviour. ConsoleFormat Text (default Json) writes the console as one readable line per event with the trace id and the ConsoleTextProperties (default Jti); OTLP and file stay structured. Fixes: EnableOtlpExporter=false set in code also skips the OpenTelemetry SDK exporter, an OpenTelemetry 1.15 registration made before AddStepUpLogging is detected again, and level options accept level names only. See CHANGELOG.md. v5.3.0 - Pre-error buffer exclude categories (#79): PreErrorBufferExcludeCategories (default empty) keeps the listed SourceContext prefixes' events below Warning out of the pre-error buffer, so an Error flush does not export them; other categories still flush and Diagnostic mode is unaffected. See CHANGELOG.md. v5.2.0 - Stalled drain made visible (#71): audit_spool_oldest_age_seconds gauge, opt-in health signal (EncryptedSpoolOptions.OldestRecordMaxAge, OldestRecordStatus), a reason tag on audit_spool_dead_lettered_total, and the documented answer for an unknown key (503 while keys load, 422 when gone). See CHANGELOG.md. v5.1.0 - Encrypted spool throughput (#69): opt-in batched delivery (EncryptedSpoolOptions.DeliveryBatchSize, POST {EndpointBaseUrl}/audit/batch; default 1 keeps the wire unchanged); concurrent durable writes no longer queue behind one gate, the cap still holds; a full spool refuses from its tally and re-checks the disk at most once per SpoolFullRecheckInterval instead of scanning the directory on every write; dropped records are logged at Critical at a bounded rate. See CHANGELOG.md.
